object.content: I've used git on a few of my projects, but besides knowing what commands I needed to type to post my files to GitHub, I didn't know how git or its commands actually worked. I found http://gitref.org/index.html today and it was exactly what I wanted. It went through everything about git with clear writing and excellent examples. I couldn't recommend it more.
